capabilities: export notes as vector PDFs with selectable text and embedded fonts
export notes as self-contained HTML5 files with embedded CSS and base64 images
keep lines, table rows and headings uncut across page breaks
apply theme, custom, or neutral color schemes to exports
export via commands, ribbon icon, or right-click file menu
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; exports are saved into a configurable vault folder (default exports/) rather than outside the vault.
intentEvidence: The 1.x behaviour (a picture of the rendered note, optional invisible text layer) remains available
motivation: The README implies version 1.x used image-based export and the author rebuilt it as vector output, but no motivation is stated explicitly.
problem: Obsidian's built-in export produces page-snapshot PDFs via a print dialog, which does not work reliably on Android and gives large image-based files.

relations.evidence: Generated directly in JavaScript (pdf-lib): no print dialog, works on Android.

summary: Export plugin that converts notes into vector PDFs or self-contained HTML5 files with clean built-in styling, on desktop and Android.
